LESSON: SELF-AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: Self-awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Self-awareness. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how friends?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate love and care for self and others for peaceful co-existence
2. appreciate his/her body as a temple of Paramatma. 1.2 Panch Mahabhoot a) name the celestial bodies in (Elements of Nature): creation
3. identify the celestial bodies in Akash(sky in accordance to day and (5 lesson)
4. appreciate the celestial bodies in Akash(sky) as part of Paramatma’s creation.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate love and care for self and others for peaceful co-existence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate love and care for self and others for peaceful co-existence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate his/her body as a temple of Paramatma. 1.2 Panch Mahabhoot a) name the celestial bodies in (Elements of Nature): creation
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate his/her body as a temple of Paramatma. 1.2 Panch Mahabhoot a) name the celestial bodies in (Elements of Nature): creation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. identify the celestial bodies in Akash(sky in accordance to day and (5 lesson)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the celestial bodies in Akash(sky in accordance to day and (5 lesson). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the celestial bodies in Akash(sky) as part of Paramatma’s creation.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the celestial bodies in Akash(sky) as part of Paramatma’s creation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Self-awareness.
2. Explain Self-awareness to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Self-awareness.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate love and care for self and others for peaceful co-existence
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Self-awareness. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how friends?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate love and care for self and others for peaceful co-existence
2. appreciate his/her body as a temple of Paramatma. 1.2 Panch Mahabhoot a) name the celestial bodies in (Elements of Nature): creation
3. identify the celestial bodies in Akash(sky in accordance to day and (5 lesson)
4. appreciate the celestial bodies in Akash(sky) as part of Paramatma’s creation.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
